query: search internal docs database production schema SQL payments columns

args.sql: SELECT c.table_schema, c.table_name, c.column_name, c.data_type, pg_catalog.col_description(pc.oid, c.ordinal_position) AS column_comment FROM information_schema.columns c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pn ON pn.nspname = c.table_schema JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pc ON pc.relnamespace = pn.oid AND pc.relname = c.table_name WHERE c.table_name = 'payments' ORDER BY c.table_schema, c.ordinal_position;
